title: 全書架構與風險
en: How the Book Is Organized, and Why Risk Matters

vocab.example: successful investing involves thoughtful attention to many areas simultaneously
vocab.def: 指幾件事在同一時間發生。作者的重點是：投資要同時顧到許多面向，但書只能一章一章寫。
vocab.exzh: 成功的投資需要同時用心關注許多領域

vocab.example: Thus I begin with a discussion of the market environment in which investing takes place, to establish the playing field.
vocab.def: 本指運動場，比喻競爭發生的環境與規則。作者先介紹市場環境，就是先把場地交代清楚。
vocab.exzh: 因此我從討論投資所處的市場環境開始，先把這個競技場交代清楚。

vocab.example: Then I go on to discuss investors themselves, the elements that affect their investment success or lack of it, and the things they should do to improve their chances.
vocab.def: go on to do 表示做完前一件事之後，接著做下一件。不是「繼續做同一件事」（那是 go on doing）。
vocab.exzh: 接著我繼續討論投資人本身、影響他們投資成敗的要素，以及他們為了提高成功機率該做的事。

vocab.example: The final chapters are an attempt to pull together both groups of ideas into a summation.
vocab.def: 把前面所有內容合起來作結的部分。比 summary 更正式，帶有「合起來」的意味。
vocab.exzh: 最後幾章是嘗試把兩組想法整合起來，作成總結。

vocab.example: Because my philosophy is “of a piece,” however, some ideas are relevant to more than one chapter;
vocab.def: 像一整塊東西，各部分彼此相連、無法切開。所以作者說，有些想法會在不只一章出現。
vocab.exzh: 不過，因為我的哲學是一個整體，有些想法會與不只一章相關；

vocab.example: please bear with me if you sense repetition.
vocab.def: bear with me 是請對方忍耐一下的禮貌說法。這裡的 bear 讀 /bɛr/，和「熊」同音。
vocab.exzh: 如果你覺得有重複，還請多包涵。

vocab.example: I hope you’ll find this book’s contents novel, thought provoking and perhaps even controversial.
vocab.def: 這裡不是「小說」，而是形容詞「新奇的」。作者希望書中的想法是讀者沒看過的。
vocab.exzh: 我希望你會覺得這本書的內容新穎、發人深省，甚至或許有爭議。

vocab.example: I hope you’ll find this book’s contents novel, thought provoking and perhaps even controversial.
vocab.def: 會引起不同意見爭論的。作者把它當成優點，因為不同於主流的想法才有價值。
vocab.exzh: 我希望你會覺得這本書的內容新穎、發人深省，甚至或許有爭議。

vocab.example: I so enjoyed your book; it bore out everything I’ve ever read,”
vocab.def: 某個說法或結果「證明另一件事是對的」。課文裡是讀者說：這本書印證了我讀過的一切，也就是毫無新意。
vocab.exzh: 我好喜歡你的書，它印證了我讀過的一切，」

vocab.example: ideas and ways of thinking about investment matters that you haven’t come across before
vocab.def: 沒有特別去找，卻遇到某樣東西。這裡的 come across 後面省略了受詞，因為前面的關係代名詞已經是受詞。
vocab.exzh: 你以前從未接觸過的、關於投資事務的想法和思考方式

sentences.en: A word about the organization of the book.
sentences.zh: 關於本書的編排，我先說幾句。

sentences.en: I mentioned above that successful investing involves thoughtful attention to many areas simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 我在前面提過，成功的投資需要同時用心關注許多領域。

sentences.en: If it were somehow possible to do so, I would discuss all of them at once.
sentences.zh: 如果有辦法的話，我會把它們一次全部講完。

sentences.en: But unfortunately the limitations of language force me to take one topic at a time.
sentences.zh: 但遺憾的是，語言的限制逼得我只能一次談一個主題。

sentences.en: Thus I begin with a discussion of the market environment in which investing takes place, to establish the playing field.
sentences.zh: 因此我從討論投資所處的市場環境開始，先把這個競技場交代清楚。

sentences.en: Then I go on to discuss investors themselves, the elements that affect their investment success or lack of it, and the things they should do to improve their chances.
sentences.zh: 接著我討論投資人本身、影響他們投資成敗的要素，以及他們為了提高成功機率該做的事。

sentences.en: The final chapters are an attempt to pull together both groups of ideas into a summation.
sentences.zh: 最後幾章是嘗試把這兩組想法整合起來，作成總結。

sentences.en: Because my philosophy is “of a piece,” however, some ideas are relevant to more than one chapter;
sentences.zh: 不過，因為我的哲學是一個整體，有些想法會與不只一章相關；

sentences.en: please bear with me if you sense repetition.
sentences.zh: 如果你覺得有重複，還請多包涵。

sentences.en: I hope you’ll find this book’s contents novel, thought provoking and perhaps even controversial.
sentences.zh: 我希望你會覺得這本書的內容新穎、發人深省，甚至或許有爭議。

sentences.en: If anyone tells me, “I so enjoyed your book; it bore out everything I’ve ever read,” I’ll feel I failed.
sentences.zh: 如果有人對我說：「我好喜歡你的書，它印證了我讀過的一切」，我會覺得自己失敗了。

sentences.en: It’s my goal to share ideas and ways of thinking about investment matters that you haven’t come across before.
sentences.zh: 我的目標是分享你以前從未接觸過的、關於投資事務的想法與思考方式。

sentences.en: Heaven for me would be seven little words: “I never thought of it that way.”
sentences.zh: 對我來說，天堂就是七個小字：「我從沒那樣想過。」

sentences.en: In particular, you’ll find I spend more time discussing risk and how to limit it than how to achieve investment returns.
sentences.zh: 特別是，你會發現我花更多篇幅討論風險以及如何限制風險，而不是如何賺取投資報酬。

sentences.en: To me, risk is the most interesting, challenging and essential aspect of investing.
sentences.zh: 對我來說，風險是投資中最有趣、最具挑戰、也最不可或缺的一環。

grammar.point: 與現在事實相反的假設：If it were …, I would …
grammar.quote: If it were somehow possible to do so, I would discuss all of them at once.
grammar.explain:
If 子句用過去式（be 動詞一律用 were），主要子句用 would＋原形，表示「與現在事實相反或幾乎不可能」的假設。
所以這句話的真正意思是：事實上做不到，所以我沒辦法一次全講完。看到 If it were，就知道後面說的是假想。

grammar.point: 介系詞＋關係代名詞：in which investing takes place
grammar.quote: Thus I begin with a discussion of the market environment in which investing takes place, to establish the playing field.
grammar.explain:
in which investing takes place 修飾 the market environment，意思是「投資在其中進行的」市場環境。
因為 take place 後面不帶受詞，所以關代放在介系詞 in 後面。口語常會寫成 the environment that investing takes place in，意思相同，但書面語更常用 in which。

grammar.point: more … than …：比較的兩邊是同類結構
grammar.quote: In particular, you’ll find I spend more time discussing risk and how to limit it than how to achieve investment returns.
grammar.explain:
I spend more time discussing A than (discussing) B。A 是 risk and how to limit it，B 是 how to achieve investment returns，than 之前省略的是 discussing。
比較級的兩邊要對稱：這裡兩邊都是「討論＋名詞或 how to 片語」。把省略的詞補回去，句子就清楚了。
